scope: Local whitened GLS response geometry at the pinned exploratory SN-only IVS profile point. This is not a posterior, uncertainty, significance, evidence, or full physical-model calculation.

implementation.forward_model: Standalone SciPy RK45 ODE with analytic forward sensitivities; no production scorer/ODE imports.
implementation.cross_check: Separately written base-only ODE central differences over parameter steps 1e-2 to 1e-6.
implementation.intercept: One common magnitude intercept removed by rank-aware SVD projection.

interpretation: At this point the SN-only interaction response is strongly aligned with the Omega_m response, so these parameters are locally degenerate in this probe and coordinate system. The near-zero residual projection onto the nuisance-projected interaction direction is consistent with first-order stationarity at the jointly fitted minimum; it is a fit-consistency diagnostic, not independent evidence against IVS. Combined with the separately reported matched-null calibration, this makes further flexible SN-only background fitting low priority; it does not rule out or validate the full physical model.
limits: Local derivative geometry at one selected point; condition number and local information depend on parameter coordinates and are not posterior widths.
No optimization, mocks, posterior, calibrated interval, significance, or evidence calculation was performed in this audit.
The calculation is a late-time SN-only background response; it does not test perturbations, CMB, growth, early-time stability, or combine BAO and SN.
